metadata.title: Aflibercept and FOLFIRI Therapy -14 day
metadata.indication: Second-line treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer resistant to or progressed after an oxaliplatin-containing regimen.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

metadata.schedule_summary: Day 1: aflibercept, then irinotecan, folinic acid and fluorouracil, followed by a 46-hour fluorouracil pump. Repeat every 14 days while beneficial and tolerable.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: JSON assessment encoding derived from NCCP 00238 version 6. Confirm the current official NCCP PDF and use independent clinical judgement. Independent clinical and oncology-pharmacy validation remain pending.

indications.description: Second-line treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer resistant to or progressed after an oxaliplatin-containing regimen.
Metastatic colorectal cancer after progression on an oxaliplatin-containing regimen.

administration.notes: Infuse over 90 minutes; may share Y-connector with folinic acid, not the same bag.
Infuse over 2 hours before 5-FU; 200 mg/m² may be considered per source.
Continuous 46-hour pump after bolus; arranged disconnection.

output_templates.contraindicated: The entered data trigger a protocol exclusion or contraindication pathway.
output_templates.discontinue: The entered data trigger protocol discontinuation.
output_templates.withhold: Hold treatment and follow the protocol reassessment pathway.
output_templates.consultant_review: Consultant review is required before treatment proceeds.
output_templates.dose_reduce: Treatment may proceed only after the encoded component modifications are reviewed and prescribed.
output_templates.proceed: No encoded dose-modification criterion was triggered by the entered data.

rule_engine.conflict_policy: Use the most restrictive overall action; combine component changes using the greatest reduction per component rather than summing reductions.
rule_engine.missing_data_policy: Do not infer missing clinical values, recovery, recurrence or current component doses. Independently actionable abnormal values trigger their pathway without requiring unrelated inputs.

action.recommendation: Source caution: Previous pelvic radiotherapy. Confirm suitability and monitoring before treatment.

rules.explanation: Source caution: Previous pelvic radiotherapy. Confirm suitability and monitoring before treatment.

action.recommendation: Delay aflibercept/FOLFIRI until ANC ≥1.5 ×10⁹/L and platelets ≥75 ×10⁹/L. No duration input is needed to recognise this hold. The source uses “or” for recovery; confirm both counts before prescribing.

rules.explanation: Delay aflibercept/FOLFIRI until ANC ≥1.5 ×10⁹/L and platelets ≥75 ×10⁹/L. No duration input is needed to recognise this hold. The source uses “or” for recovery; confirm both counts before prescribing.

action.recommendation: Delay aflibercept/FOLFIRI until platelets ≥75 ×10⁹/L and ANC ≥1.5 ×10⁹/L. NCCP 00238 gives no automatic two/four-week discontinuation or nadir dose-level algorithm.

rules.explanation: Delay aflibercept/FOLFIRI until platelets ≥75 ×10⁹/L and ANC ≥1.5 ×10⁹/L. NCCP 00238 gives no automatic two/four-week discontinuation or nadir dose-level algorithm.

action.recommendation: Current febrile neutropenia/neutropenic sepsis needs urgent treatment and clinical recovery. Do not give a future reduced dose during an active episode.

rules.explanation: Current febrile neutropenia/neutropenic sepsis needs urgent treatment and clinical recovery. Do not give a future reduced dose during an active episode.

action.recommendation: Establish occurrence number and recovery. NCCP 00238 uses recurrence-specific percentages: not the standard FOLFIRI two-dose-level reduction.

rules.explanation: Establish occurrence number and recovery. NCCP 00238 uses recurrence-specific percentages: not the standard FOLFIRI two-dose-level reduction.

action.recommendation: First febrile neutropenia/neutropenic sepsis: after recovery reduce irinotecan by 15–20% in subsequent cycles. The consultant selects within the source range after reviewing the actual administered dose; no automatic midpoint or starting-dose calculation.

rules.explanation: First febrile neutropenia/neutropenic sepsis: after recovery reduce irinotecan by 15–20% in subsequent cycles. The consultant selects within the source range after reviewing the actual administered dose; no automatic midpoint or starting-dose calculation.

action.recommendation: Second occurrence: after recovery additionally reduce both 5-FU bolus and infusion by 20%; maintain the previously reduced irinotecan dose. Confirm actual component doses and whether each reduction has already been applied; do not compound or reverse earlier changes automatically.

rules.explanation: Second occurrence: after recovery additionally reduce both 5-FU bolus and infusion by 20%; maintain the previously reduced irinotecan dose. Confirm actual component doses and whether each reduction has already been applied; do not compound or reverse earlier changes automatically.

action.recommendation: Third occurrence: aflibercept 2 mg/kg and G-CSF may be considered; this is a consultant choice, not an automatic dose. Reconcile previous irinotecan and fluorouracil reductions and current recovery. Later occurrences need individual review.

rules.explanation: Third occurrence: aflibercept 2 mg/kg and G-CSF may be considered; this is a consultant choice, not an automatic dose. Reconcile previous irinotecan and fluorouracil reductions and current recovery. Later occurrences need individual review.

action.recommendation: Confirm infection recovery and both current counts before any subsequent cycle; recurrence information alone does not establish readiness to restart.

rules.explanation: Confirm infection recovery and both current counts before any subsequent cycle; recurrence information alone does not establish readiness to restart.

action.recommendation: CrCl <10 mL/min or haemodialysis: Table 1 gives a starting range of 50–66% of original irinotecan, with escalation if tolerated. Page 2 also lists impaired renal function as an exclusion. Resolve this source conflict with consultant/pharmacy; no automatic dose or midpoint.

rules.explanation: CrCl <10 mL/min or haemodialysis: Table 1 gives a starting range of 50–66% of original irinotecan, with escalation if tolerated. Page 2 also lists impaired renal function as an exclusion. Resolve this source conflict with consultant/pharmacy; no automatic dose or midpoint.

action.recommendation: Page 2 lists impaired renal function as an exclusion, while Table 1 provides renal dosing including severe impairment. Resolve eligibility and dosing with consultant/pharmacy; do not infer treatment clearance from the dose table.

rules.explanation: Page 2 lists impaired renal function as an exclusion, while Table 1 provides renal dosing including severe impairment. Resolve eligibility and dosing with consultant/pharmacy; do not infer treatment clearance from the dose table.

action.recommendation: Irinotecan is contraindicated when bilirubin >3 ×ULN. Review the entire combination before prescribing.

rules.explanation: Irinotecan is contraindicated when bilirubin >3 ×ULN. Review the entire combination before prescribing.

action.recommendation: 5-FU is contraindicated in the source table when bilirubin >85 µmol/L or AST >180 U/L.

rules.explanation: 5-FU is contraindicated in the source table when bilirubin >85 µmol/L or AST >180 U/L.

action.recommendation: Exact bilirubin 85 µmol/L or AST 180 U/L is not assigned by the strict < / > source bands. Consultant/pharmacy review; no automatic full dose.

rules.explanation: Exact bilirubin 85 µmol/L or AST 180 U/L is not assigned by the strict < / > source bands. Consultant/pharmacy review; no automatic full dose.

action.recommendation: Clinical decision: for moderate hepatic impairment the source describes reducing the initial fluorouracil dose by one third, then increasing if no toxicity. Reconcile absolute bilirubin/AST contraindications, whether this is initial treatment, and actual component dose history; no automatic recalculation.

rules.explanation: Clinical decision: for moderate hepatic impairment the source describes reducing the initial fluorouracil dose by one third, then increasing if no toxicity. Reconcile absolute bilirubin/AST contraindications, whether this is initial treatment, and actual component dose history; no automatic recalculation.

action.recommendation: Clinical decision: for severe hepatic impairment the source describes reducing the initial fluorouracil dose by one half, then increasing if no toxicity. Reconcile absolute bilirubin/AST contraindications, whether this is initial treatment, and actual component dose history; no automatic recalculation.

rules.explanation: Clinical decision: for severe hepatic impairment the source describes reducing the initial fluorouracil dose by one half, then increasing if no toxicity. Reconcile absolute bilirubin/AST contraindications, whether this is initial treatment, and actual component dose history; no automatic recalculation.

action.recommendation: The source full-dose hepatic band requires BOTH bilirubin <85 µmol/L AND AST <180 U/L. The omitted result remains unassessed; do not treat a single low value as full hepatic clearance.

rules.explanation: The source full-dose hepatic band requires BOTH bilirubin <85 µmol/L AND AST <180 U/L. The omitted result remains unassessed; do not treat a single low value as full hepatic clearance.

action.recommendation: Documented UGT 1 A 1 poor-metaboliser context requires consultant/pharmacy assessment against current irinotecan product information. NCCP 00238 v 6 does not specify a genotype-based numeric dose; none is calculated here.

rules.explanation: Documented UGT 1 A 1 poor-metaboliser context requires consultant/pharmacy assessment against current irinotecan product information. NCCP 00238 v 6 does not specify a genotype-based numeric dose; none is calculated here.

action.recommendation: Temporarily suspend aflibercept infusion until the reaction resolves. Corticosteroid/antihistamine treatment and subsequent pre-treatment may be considered clinically.

rules.explanation: Temporarily suspend aflibercept infusion until the reaction resolves. Corticosteroid/antihistamine treatment and subsequent pre-treatment may be considered clinically.

action.recommendation: Severe hypersensitivity reaction: discontinue aflibercept/FOLFIRI.

rules.explanation: Severe hypersensitivity reaction: discontinue aflibercept/FOLFIRI.

action.recommendation: Suspend aflibercept for proteinuria ≥2 g/24 hours; resume only after <2 g/24 hours. On the second occurrence, permanently reduce to 2 mg/kg after recovery; confirm occurrence and current dose.

rules.explanation: Suspend aflibercept for proteinuria ≥2 g/24 hours; resume only after <2 g/24 hours. On the second occurrence, permanently reduce to 2 mg/kg after recovery; confirm occurrence and current dose.

action.recommendation: After the second proteinuria occurrence and documented recovery below 2 g/24 hours, the source requires permanent aflibercept reduction to 2 mg/kg. Confirm current dose and previous reductions; no re-escalation or automatic restart from an isolated result.

rules.explanation: After the second proteinuria occurrence and documented recovery below 2 g/24 hours, the source requires permanent aflibercept reduction to 2 mg/kg. Confirm current dose and previous reductions; no re-escalation or automatic restart from an isolated result.

action.recommendation: A prior proteinuria episode requires a current 24-hour result before restart; recurrence number does not establish recovery below 2 g/24 hours.

rules.explanation: A prior proteinuria episode requires a current 24-hour result before restart; recurrence number does not establish recovery below 2 g/24 hours.

action.recommendation: UPCR >1 requires 24-hour urine collection. The UPCR is not interchangeable with grams of protein per 24 hours; assess the quantitative result before dose decisions.

rules.explanation: UPCR >1 requires 24-hour urine collection. The UPCR is not interchangeable with grams of protein per 24 hours; assess the quantitative result before dose decisions.

action.recommendation: Withhold aflibercept until hypertension is controlled. Recurrence of medically significant/severe hypertension requires permanent reduction to 2 mg/kg after control; persistent uncontrolled hypertension follows the stop pathway.

rules.explanation: Withhold aflibercept until hypertension is controlled. Recurrence of medically significant/severe hypertension requires permanent reduction to 2 mg/kg after control; persistent uncontrolled hypertension follows the stop pathway.

action.recommendation: Recurrent medically significant/severe hypertension: suspend until controlled, then permanently reduce aflibercept to 2 mg/kg. Confirm control and current dose before prescribing; do not re-escalate.

rules.explanation: Recurrent medically significant/severe hypertension: suspend until controlled, then permanently reduce aflibercept to 2 mg/kg. Confirm control and current dose before prescribing; do not re-escalate.

action.recommendation: Recurrent significant hypertension: do not restart aflibercept before control is documented.

rules.explanation: Recurrent significant hypertension: do not restart aflibercept before control is documented.

action.recommendation: Discontinue aflibercept: Persistent uncontrolled hypertension (source permanent-stop pathway). This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

rules.explanation: Discontinue aflibercept: Persistent uncontrolled hypertension (source permanent-stop pathway). This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

action.recommendation: Discontinue aflibercept: Hypertensive crisis or hypertensive encephalopathy. This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

rules.explanation: Discontinue aflibercept: Hypertensive crisis or hypertensive encephalopathy. This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

action.recommendation: Discontinue aflibercept: Active severe bleeding. This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

action.recommendation: Discontinue aflibercept: Gastrointestinal perforation or fistula. This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

action.recommendation: Discontinue aflibercept: Arterial thromboembolic event. This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

rules.explanation: Discontinue aflibercept: Arterial thromboembolic event. This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

action.recommendation: Discontinue aflibercept: Grade 4 venous thromboembolism including pulmonary embolism. This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

rules.explanation: Discontinue aflibercept: Grade 4 venous thromboembolism including pulmonary embolism. This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

action.recommendation: Discontinue aflibercept: Nephrotic syndrome or thrombotic microangiopathy. This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

rules.explanation: Discontinue aflibercept: Nephrotic syndrome or thrombotic microangiopathy. This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

action.recommendation: Discontinue aflibercept: Compromised wound healing requiring medical intervention. This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

rules.explanation: Discontinue aflibercept: Compromised wound healing requiring medical intervention. This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

action.recommendation: Discontinue aflibercept: Posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome. This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

rules.explanation: Discontinue aflibercept: Posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome. This component-specific rule does not itself discontinue the FOLFIRI components.

action.recommendation: Suspend aflibercept for at least 4 weeks before elective surgery. Confirm surgical timing and healing with the treating team.

rules.explanation: Suspend aflibercept for at least 4 weeks before elective surgery. Confirm surgical timing and healing with the treating team.

action.recommendation: Recent major surgery/unhealed wound: suspend aflibercept pending surgical and oncology review. Wound healing requiring medical intervention follows the permanent-stop pathway.

rules.explanation: Recent major surgery/unhealed wound: suspend aflibercept pending surgical and oncology review. Wound healing requiring medical intervention follows the permanent-stop pathway.

action.recommendation: Current clinically significant diarrhoea needs assessment, hydration and antidiarrhoeal treatment before further FOLFIRI. NCCP 00238 does not supply the standard FOLFIRI grade 2/two-week dose-level algorithm; assess severity and recovery explicitly.

rules.explanation: Current clinically significant diarrhoea needs assessment, hydration and antidiarrhoeal treatment before further FOLFIRI. NCCP 00238 does not supply the standard FOLFIRI grade 2/two-week dose-level algorithm; assess severity and recovery explicitly.

action.recommendation: Active severe diarrhoea: withhold FOLFIRI pending urgent clinical assessment, hydration and recovery. Use this regimen’s occurrence-specific subsequent-cycle reduction pathway.

rules.explanation: Active severe diarrhoea: withhold FOLFIRI pending urgent clinical assessment, hydration and recovery. Use this regimen’s occurrence-specific subsequent-cycle reduction pathway.

action.recommendation: Severe diarrhoea: establish occurrence, recovery and actual component doses. First occurrence reduces irinotecan 15–20%; second additionally reduces both fluorouracil doses 20%. Do not import dose levels or assume a midpoint.

rules.explanation: Severe diarrhoea: establish occurrence, recovery and actual component doses. First occurrence reduces irinotecan 15–20%; second additionally reduces both fluorouracil doses 20%. Do not import dose levels or assume a midpoint.

action.recommendation: First severe diarrhoea: after clinical recovery reduce irinotecan by 15–20%. Select the reduction with the consultant against the documented administered dose; no numeric range midpoint is calculated.

rules.explanation: First severe diarrhoea: after clinical recovery reduce irinotecan by 15–20%. Select the reduction with the consultant against the documented administered dose; no numeric range midpoint is calculated.

action.recommendation: Second severe diarrhoea: additionally reduce both 5-FU bolus and infusion by 20%, retaining the irinotecan reduction. Confirm recovery and whether each change has already been applied. Persistent severe diarrhoea despite BOTH reductions requires discontinuation of FOLFIRI.

rules.explanation: Second severe diarrhoea: additionally reduce both 5-FU bolus and infusion by 20%, retaining the irinotecan reduction. Confirm recovery and whether each change has already been applied. Persistent severe diarrhoea despite BOTH reductions requires discontinuation of FOLFIRI.

action.recommendation: Severe diarrhoea persisting despite BOTH irinotecan and fluorouracil reductions: discontinue FOLFIRI. This rule does not automatically discontinue aflibercept; the future overall plan requires consultant review.

rules.explanation: Severe diarrhoea persisting despite BOTH irinotecan and fluorouracil reductions: discontinue FOLFIRI. This rule does not automatically discontinue aflibercept; the future overall plan requires consultant review.

action.recommendation: Severe stomatitis/PPE: reduce both fluorouracil bolus and infusion by 20% after clinical recovery. Confirm the source term “severe”, current component doses and whether the reduction is already applied; no borrowed dose levels.

action.recommendation: Confirm the actual last administered component doses and previous reductions before any percentage-based modification. Do not reduce from an assumed protocol starting dose or apply the same reduction twice.

regimen_specific_notes: Atropine 250 micrograms SC before irinotecan except contraindicated glaucoma; caution in asthma.

Delayed diarrhoea (>24 hours after irinotecan): loperamide 4 mg then 2 mg every 2 hours, continuing 12 hours after last liquid stool, maximum 48 hours at this schedule; use the treating team’s instructions.
Ice chips may be used during the 5-FU bolus to reduce stomatitis.

monitoring: Baseline and each cycle: FBC, renal/liver profile and urine protein dipstick; BP monitoring.
DPD before first fluorouracil unless previously tested; renal impairment may affect uracil phenotyping.
UPCR >1: obtain 24-hour urine protein. ECG at baseline if compromised cardiac function.
INR on warfarin as clinically indicated. Disease imaging/other monitoring follows the consultant’s treatment plan.

treatment.schedule_summary: Day 1: aflibercept, then irinotecan, folinic acid and fluorouracil, followed by a 46-hour fluorouracil pump. Repeat every 14 days while beneficial and tolerable.
